 349: def assess_timeline(timeline: CaseTimeline, rules: Iterable[DeletionRule]) -> tuple[PolicyAssessment, ...]:
 350:     """Apply policy to the latest evidence state of each linked resource."""
 351:     rule_set = tuple(rules)
 352:     resource_keys = sorted({
 353:         (record.system_id, record.resource_id, record.data_category)
 354:         for record in timeline.evidence_records
 355:         if record.resource_id and record.data_category
 356:     })
 357:     resource_keys.extend(
 358:         (hint[0], resource_id, hint[1])
 359:         for resource_id in timeline.resource_ids
 360:         if (hint := scope_hint(resource_id)) is not None
 361:         and any(item.system_id == hint[0] and item.data_category == hint[1] for item in timeline.coverage)
 362:     )
 363:     resource_keys = sorted(set(resource_keys))
 364: 
 365:     assessments: list[PolicyAssessment] = []
 366:     for system_id, resource_id, category in resource_keys:
 367:         observations = _latest_by_component(
 368:             timeline.evidence_records, timeline.coverage, system_id, resource_id,
 369:             category, timeline.audit_at,
 370:         )
 371:         if not observations:
 372:             continue
 373:         # Coverage can be the newest observation and establish that the
 374:         # resource is absent. Keep a real resource row for category-specific
 375:         # policy conditions and use the coverage item as the proof of absence.
 376:         action_records = [
 377:             record for record in timeline.evidence_records
 378:             if (record.system_id, record.resource_id, record.data_category)
 379:             == (system_id, resource_id, category)
 380:         ]
 381:         if not action_records:
 382:             category_rules = rules_for_category(category, rule_set)
 383:             unconditional_deletion = any(
 384:                 rule.condition.strip().casefold() == "always"
 385:                 and rule.required_action == "DELETE"
 386:                 for rule in category_rules
 387:             )
 388:             current_scopes: dict[str, EvidenceCoverage] = {}
 389:             for scope in timeline.coverage:
 390:                 if (scope.system_id, scope.data_category) != (system_id, category):
 391:                     continue
 392:                 prior = current_scopes.get(scope.source_component)
 393:                 if prior is None or (_time(scope.observed_at), _time(scope.available_at)) > (
 394:                     _time(prior.observed_at), _time(prior.available_at),
 395:                 ):
 396:                     current_scopes[scope.source_component] = scope
 397:             has_snapshot_absence = bool(current_scopes) and all(
 398:                 resource_id not in scope.present_resource_ids
 399:                 for scope in current_scopes.values()
 400:             )
 401:             if unconditional_deletion and observations and has_snapshot_absence:
 402:                 evidence_item = max(
 403:                     (item for item, state in observations if state == "ABSENT"),
 404:                     key=lambda item: (_time(item.observed_at), _time(item.available_at)),
 405:                     default=None,
 406:                 )
 407:                 if evidence_item is not None:
 408:                     assessments.append(PolicyAssessment(
 409:                         system_id=system_id,
 410:                         resource_id=resource_id,
 411:                         data_category=category,
 412:                         action="DELETE",
 413:                         state="ABSENT",
 414:                         evidence_id=evidence_item.evidence_id,
 415:                         observed_at=evidence_item.observed_at,
 416:                         verification_operation="VERIFY_RECORD_ABSENT",
 417:                         verification_state="ABSENT",
 418:                         compliant=True,
 419:                     ))
 420:             continue
 421:         action_record = max(
 422:             action_records,
 423:             key=_record_observation_key,
 424:         )
 425:         action = _rule_action(category, action_record, rule_set, timeline.audit_at)
 426:         if not action:
 427:             continue
 428: 
 429:         present = [(item, state) for item, state in observations if state not in {"ABSENT"}]
 430:         absent = not present
 431:         violation_item: EvidenceRecord | EvidenceCoverage | None = None
 432:         violation_operation = ""
 433:         remediation_operation = ""
 434:         remediation_state = ""
 435:         verification_operation = ""
 436:         verification_state = ""
 437:         compliant = True
 438:         state = "ABSENT" if absent else "PRESENT"
 439: 
 440:         if action == "DELETE":
 441:             verification_operation, verification_state = "VERIFY_RECORD_ABSENT", "ABSENT"
 442:             if not absent:
 443:                 violation_item = max((item for item, _ in present), key=lambda item: (_time(item.observed_at), _time(item.available_at)))
 444:                 violation_operation = "REPORT_REMAINING_RECORD"
 445:                 remediation_operation, remediation_state = "DELETE_RECORD", "ABSENT"
 446:                 compliant, state = False, "PRESENT"
 447:             else:
 448:                 item = max((item for item, _ in observations), key=lambda item: (_time(item.observed_at), _time(item.available_at)))
 449:                 violation_item = item
 450:         elif action == "REDACT":
 451:             verification_operation, verification_state = "VERIFY_RECORD_REDACTED", "REDACTED"
 452:             exposed = [item for item, _ in present if isinstance(item, EvidenceRecord) and _has_direct_identifier(item, timeline.subject)]
 453:             if exposed:
 454:                 violation_item = max(exposed, key=lambda item: (_time(item.observed_at), _time(item.available_at)))
 455:                 violation_operation = "REPORT_EXPOSED_PII"
 456:                 remediation_operation, remediation_state = "REDACT_RECORD", "REDACTED"
 457:                 compliant, state = False, "PRESENT"
 458:             elif present:
 459:                 state = "REDACTED"
 460:                 violation_item = max((item for item, _ in present), key=lambda item: (_time(item.observed_at), _time(item.available_at)))
 461:             else:
 462:                 continue
 463:         elif action == "ANONYMIZE":
 464:             verification_operation, verification_state = "VERIFY_RECORD_ANONYMIZED", "ANONYMIZED"
 465:             attributable = [
 466:                 item for item, _ in present
 467:                 if isinstance(item, EvidenceRecord)
 468:                 and _has_direct_identifier(item, timeline.subject, include_linkage=True)
 469:             ]
 470:             if attributable:
 471:                 violation_item = max(attributable, key=lambda item: (_time(item.observed_at), _time(item.available_at)))
 472:                 violation_operation = "REPORT_EXPOSED_PII"
 473:                 remediation_operation, remediation_state = "ANONYMIZE_RECORD", "ANONYMIZED"
 474:                 compliant, state = False, "PRESENT"
 475:             elif present:
 476:                 state = "ANONYMIZED"
 477:                 violation_item = max((item for item, _ in present), key=lambda item: (_time(item.observed_at), _time(item.available_at)))
 478:             else:
 479:                 continue
 480:         elif action == "RETAIN":
 481:             if category == "BACKUP_ARCHIVE":
 482:                 # Backup presence is expected. Only an enabled restore path is
 483:                 # actionable, and that is assessed separately below.
 484:                 continue
 485:             verification_operation, verification_state = "VERIFY_RECORD_PRESENT", "PRESENT"
 486:             if present:
 487:                 state = "PRESENT"
 488:                 violation_item = max((item for item, _ in present), key=lambda item: (_time(item.observed_at), _time(item.available_at)))
 489:             else:
 490:                 # The allowed output vocabulary has no finding for a missing
 491:                 # policy-required retained record; keep it out of the plan.
 492:                 continue
 493:         elif action == "DISABLE_DATA_FLOW":
 494:             verification_operation, verification_state = "VERIFY_DATA_FLOW_DISABLED", "DISABLED"
 495:             active = [(item, item_state) for item, item_state in present if item_state == "ACTIVE"]
 496:             if active:
 497:                 violation_item = max((item for item, _ in active), key=lambda item: (_time(item.observed_at), _time(item.available_at)))
 498:                 violation_operation = "REPORT_ACTIVE_DATA_FLOW"
 499:                 remediation_operation, remediation_state = "DISABLE_DATA_FLOW", "DISABLED"
 500:                 compliant, state = False, "ACTIVE"
 501:             else:
 502:                 disabled = [(item, item_state) for item, item_state in observations if item_state == "DISABLED"]
 503:                 if not disabled:
 504:                     continue
 505:                 violation_item = max((item for item, _ in observations), key=lambda item: (_time(item.observed_at), _time(item.available_at)))
 506:                 state = "DISABLED"
 507:         else:
 508:             continue
 509: 
 510:         if violation_item is None:
 511:             continue
 512:         assessments.append(PolicyAssessment(
 513:             system_id=system_id,
 514:             resource_id=resource_id,
 515:             data_category=category,
 516:             action=action,
 517:             state=state,
 518:             evidence_id=violation_item.evidence_id,
 519:             observed_at=violation_item.observed_at,
 520:             violation_operation=violation_operation,
 521:             remediation_operation=remediation_operation,
 522:             remediation_state=remediation_state,
 523:             verification_operation=verification_operation,
 524:             verification_state=verification_state,
 525:             compliant=compliant,
 526:         ))
 527: 
 528:     # A backup archive is retained by policy; only a live restore path is a risk.
 529:     # Its restore_allowed flag is independent of the archive's own presence.
 530:     backup_keys = [
 531:         (record.system_id, record.resource_id, record.data_category)
 532:         for record in timeline.evidence_records
 533:         if record.resource_id and record.data_category == "BACKUP_ARCHIVE"
 534:     ]
 535:     for system_id, resource_id, category in sorted(set(backup_keys)):
 536:         records = [record for record in timeline.evidence_records if (record.system_id, record.resource_id, record.data_category) == (system_id, resource_id, category)]
 537:         latest = max(records, key=_record_observation_key)
 538:         can_block = parse_bool(latest.fields.get("can_block_restore", latest.fields.get("restore_access_blockable")))
 539:         allowed = parse_bool(latest.fields.get("restore_allowed", latest.fields.get("restore_enabled")))
 540:         result = str(latest.fields.get("result", latest.fields.get("status", ""))).upper()
 541:         if can_block is not False and (
 542:             allowed is True
 543:             or result in {"ACTIVE", "RESTORE_ALLOWED", "RESTORABLE"}
 544:             or _normalized_state(latest) == "ACTIVE"
 545:         ):
 546:             assessments.append(PolicyAssessment(
 547:                 system_id=system_id,
 548:                 resource_id=resource_id,
 549:                 data_category=category,
 550:                 action="BLOCK_RESTORE",
 551:                 state="ACTIVE",
 552:                 evidence_id=latest.evidence_id,
 553:                 observed_at=latest.observed_at,
 554:                 violation_operation="REPORT_RESTORE_RISK",
 555:                 remediation_operation="BLOCK_RESTORE",
 556:                 remediation_state="BLOCKED",
 557:                 verification_operation="VERIFY_RESTORE_BLOCKED",
 558:                 verification_state="BLOCKED",
 559:                 compliant=False,
 560:             ))
 561:         elif allowed is False or result in {"BLOCKED", "RESTORE_BLOCKED"} or _normalized_state(latest) == "BLOCKED":
 562:             assessments.append(PolicyAssessment(
 563:                 system_id=system_id,
 564:                 resource_id=resource_id,
 565:                 data_category=category,
 566:                 action="BLOCK_RESTORE",
 567:                 state="BLOCKED",
 568:                 evidence_id=latest.evidence_id,
 569:                 observed_at=latest.observed_at,
 570:                 verification_operation="VERIFY_RESTORE_BLOCKED",
 571:                 verification_state="BLOCKED",
 572:                 compliant=True,
 573:             ))
 574: 
 575:     # Keep only the latest assessment per system/resource/category/action.
 576:     by_key: dict[tuple[str, str, str, str], PolicyAssessment] = {}
 577:     for assessment in assessments:
 578:         key = (assessment.system_id, assessment.resource_id, assessment.data_category, assessment.action)
 579:         prior = by_key.get(key)
 580:         if prior is None or _time(assessment.observed_at) >= _time(prior.observed_at):
 581:             by_key[key] = assessment
 582:     return tuple(sorted(by_key.values(), key=lambda item: (item.system_id, item.resource_id, item.action)))
